Portable Anti-Drone Jammer Shield

Interference Distance: ≥2km (Environment dependent)
Operating Frequency: 800MHz - 5.9GHz
Full-frequency jamming for diverse scenarios; long-range suppression up to 2km; supports backpack, handheld, or tripod deployment; dual power (internal battery/AC).
Get quotationWhatsApp
The portable anti-drone jammer shield forms electromagnetic shielding in specific areas by emitting radio signals. It effectively cuts off control, video transmission, and navigation links of drones, preventing them from entering controlled zones or forcing them to land or return. It can also suppress the L1 bands of GPS, BDS, GLONASS, and Galileo. The device features a full frequency range, long-range suppression, and multi-scenario adaptability, supporting external AC power, backpack usage, or tripod mounting.
  • Overview
  • Technical Specifications
  • Contact us

Key Features

  • Shield-type ergonomic design, lightweight and portable, can be operated by a single person.
  • Integrated broadband jamming, covering mainstream drone flight control and navigation frequency bands.
  • Built-in directional antenna for concentrated energy output and longer effective range.
  • Forces target drone to land or return to home point.
  • Built-in rechargeable battery, supports continuous operation for over 60 minutes.
  • One-button start, simple operation requiring no professional training.
  • Effective jamming range up to 1.5km.

Technical Specifications

ParameterDescription
Operating Frequency800MHz, 900MHz, 1.5GHz, 2.4GHz, 5.8GHz, 5.1GHz-5.9GHz
Jamming Distance≥2km (depending on environment and drone model)
Interception Response≤ 3s
Power Consumption≤400W
Continuous Operation≥30min (all bands active)
Power SupplyBuilt-in high-capacity battery
External PowerAC 220V adapter, supports charging while operating
Screen InteractionBuilt-in touchscreen design
PositioningGPS/BDS with lat/long reporting
AntennaBuilt-in
DeploymentHandheld or Tripod-mounted
CoolingActive fan cooling
Operating Temp-40°C to +65°C
Storage Temp-40°C to +75°C

Weight≤6.5kg
